svg.title: A holonomic presentation has one exact order shift
svg.desc: The fixed intrinsic base is N equals E q. The compatible holonomic maps identify E q plus L and E q plus L plus k with intrinsic S L and S L plus k. Derivative beta of v alpha equals u alpha plus beta. Both rational-low polynomial-high classes are relative to N, with cutoffs L and q plus L. The contact-map inset has curvature a mapped to minus one over a on a nonzero domain.

Exact coefficient comparison · Proposition 4.46
Intrinsic cutoff L ↔ original equation cutoff q+L, in both cases over N.
Both coordinate changes are polynomial in higher variables with basic coefficients on N.
An intrinsic determining k-jet acts through original equation order q+k.
A local map does not by itself specify a full regular fibre action
X=p, U=u−px, P=−x: dU−P dX=du−p dx.
a=uₓₓ, DₓX=a, U_XX=−1/a, U_XXX=uₓₓₓ/a³, a≠0.
At a=0 the contact direction leaves the original graph chart.
The regular finite-level action in Proposition 4.46 is actual presentation data. Example 4.47.
Proof: Proposition 4.46 and Example 4.47, (4.121)–(4.126). See Exercise 17 and Solution 17.
Context: Kruglikov–Lychagin, arXiv:1111.5480v3 §0.1. GPT-6.1 Sol (OpenAI). CC0 1.0.
